label: caiso 1 baseline
definition: First CAISO backcast baseline (2023-2025, 8760h, energy-only P1). Code-default parameters, no CAISO-specific tuning yet. Known gaps to calibrate: domestic gas overproduces because the energy-only model has no external interchange node for CAISO's ~30 TWh/yr net imports; the LP does not yet re-curtail solar (0 vs ~2.5-3 TWh reported) and shows no negative-price hours. Establishes the harness and benchmark wiring for subsequent tuning passes.
